title: Paul K. Sybrowsky
vital_facts: Baptized as a child, Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Lynne Prior, Salt Lake City Temple 1968; nine children
BS Social Science from BYU; Co-founder and President of Dynix, Inc. (Library Technology)
Counselor to Bishop; Bishop; Stake Executive Secretary; High Councilor; Stake President
President of Canada Toronto West Mission 2001-2004
